li.label: kept apart like children
li.description: The council drew a line through the colony and put us on opposite sides of it. My side is smaller.

li.label: my shifts were reshuffled
li.description: My whole week got moved around because of somebody else's trouble. Nobody asked me.

li.label: lessons from my rival
li.description: A week of being taught by someone who thinks I'm an idiot. I learned things. I will never admit it.

li.label: living in someone else's feud
li.description: Every meal is a cold war. I just want to eat my soup without picking a side.

li.label: working alongside my friend
li.description: Same shift, same crew, same bad jokes. The days go twice as fast.

li.label: night watch with a friend
li.description: Cold, dark, hours of nothing happening, and the best talks we've ever had.

li.label: posted apart from my friend
li.description: I asked to work beside my friend. The council decided the turnips need me more.

li.label: the council plays favorites
li.description: Some people ask and get. Some people have the right friends. The rest of us just work.

li.label: my friend moved on
li.description: We used to do everything together. Now they have new people, and I have the evenings.

li.label: the council meddled in my friendships
li.description: The council has opinions now about who I spend my evenings with. I didn't know that was on the agenda.

li.label: made welcome
li.description: They made room for me at their table. I didn't know how much I wanted that until I sat down.

li.label: pushed into our evenings
li.description: Our evenings came with an extra person, by arrangement. Nothing against them. Mostly.

li.label: walked away clean
li.description: I lied for a friend, and I'm the one who got off. It doesn't feel like winning.

li.label: my friend took my punishment
li.description: My mistake, their punishment. I can't look at them without feeling it.

li.label: friends covering for friends
li.description: Something goes wrong, and a friend makes up a story. Who's covering for the rest of us?

li.label: my plea was heard
li.description: I begged the council for my friend, and they listened. I'd stand up again tomorrow.

li.label: my plea fell flat
li.description: I swallowed my pride and begged for my friend. They heard me out, then did it anyway.

li.label: begged for me and made it worse
li.description: Nobody asked them to speak for me. Now I'm paying double for their good intentions.

li.label: the remembrance night
li.description: We told the whole fight by the fire, start to end, and drank to everyone who bled for this place. I slept better than I have in weeks.

li.label: told the story of the fight together
li.description: We told it the way it happened, and everyone listened. Nobody else will ever quite know what that day was like. They do.

li.label: an hour for the fight
li.description: An hour of speeches after dinner, then back to work. The fight deserved more than an hour.

li.label: the fight forgotten
li.description: We bled for this place, and the council can't spare one evening to remember it.

li.label: my things were searched
li.description: They turned out everything I own, in front of everyone, on my rival's say-so. Found nothing. I still feel their hands on it.

li.label: punished on a rival's word
li.description: No proof. Just their word against mine, and the council picked theirs.

li.label: a friend punished without proof
li.description: No proof, no hearing, just a rival pointing a finger. Could be any of us next.

li.label: made to take it back
li.description: I said I was wrong in front of everyone. I wasn't. Next time I'll bring proof, and then we'll see who apologizes.

li.label: a seat by order
li.description: They let me sit with them because the council told them to. Everyone knows it. I know it.

li.label: hosted the whole colony
li.description: I put on a supper for everyone, and people came. Even some I didn't expect.

li.label: nobody came
li.description: I set a table for the whole colony. Half the chairs stayed empty, and I know exactly whose.

li.label: credited for my work
li.description: The council said it was mine. It was. Still, it's nice to hear it said out loud.

li.label: my work went to my rival
li.description: I built it. The council says they did. Every time I walk past it, I want to knock it down.

li.label: nobody's work
li.description: Apparently it built itself. "Colony work." I'll remember that next time there's colony work to do.

li.label: counted like a thief
li.description: Every sack and every spoon counted twice, because someone doesn't like me. It all added up. Of course it did.

li.label: lost my little perks
li.description: A little extra on the plate, a slightly warmer coat. Apparently that was favoritism. Apparently it's over.

li.label: watched at my own job
li.description: Someone stands at my shoulder now and writes down every ration I hand out. Someone who hates me.

li.label: drew a bad lot
li.description: The good things go by lot now. I drew the patched coat and the burnt end of the stew. Fairness is overrated.
